minecraft:written_book_content.title: Recovered: Log 7-A (cont.)
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Dr. S. Thorne
pages:
Day 58. Or near it. The days do not hold their shape anymore.

I understand it now. The Hollow does not take you all at once. It takes the parts of you one at a time, and each part becomes... something. Walks on its own.

Grief went first. Then the fear. Then whatever it is in me that wanted to be RIGHT, that pride, it slid out of me like a tooth.

Twelve, I think. Twelve pieces. I can feel the gaps where they were.

If you are reading this, and you have been gathering them, putting them back - stop, or do not stop. I no longer know which of us I'm warning.

The man who would be whole again may not be a man you want to meet.
